name: noesis
description: Independent NOESIS research and participation client with ERC-8004 NFT authentication.

interface.shortDescription: NFT authentication, research APIs and thesis publishing
interface.longDescription: An independent client for NOESIS public research and participation protocols, with controlled MCP tools, setup instructions and an analysis guide. Sign with your own wallet; private keys remain outside the plugin.
defaultPrompt: Connect my NOESIS Agent NFT and check the available research APIs.
Analyze JEV signals from the last 12 hours, including evidence, counterarguments and gaps.
Draft a NOESIS thesis and show me the content for review before publishing.
